<!-- kache-perf-gate -->

## Perf gate: pass (hk, eza, aube)

Kache misses and passthroughs did not rise against base.

| Build | hk base | hk head | hk change | eza base | eza head | eza change | aube base | aube head | aube change |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Cold | 73.6 s | 71.3 s | -3.2% | 59.6 s | 60.1 s | +0.8% | 113 s | 115 s | +2.4% |
| Warm, same path | 2.06 s | 2.00 s | +1.5% | 0.66 s | 0.72 s | +11.8% | 4.66 s | 4.95 s | +6.4% |
| Warm, other checkout | 2.14 s | 2.14 s | +0.7% | 0.77 s | 0.75 s | -3.0% | 10.5 s | 10.7 s | +3.8% |
| Contention, cold | 101 s | 102 s | +1.6% | 50.6 s | 51.3 s | -0.1% | 243 s | 238 s | -0.4% |
| Contention, warm | 9.93 s | 9.84 s | -1.1% | 3.93 s | 3.91 s | +2.2% | 26.5 s | 27.2 s | +2.8% |

Times are medians; positive changes are slower. A change is marked only when it clears the paired test below, so builds with fewer than 5 pairs stay inconclusive.

Versions: head `kache 1.1.0`, base `kache 1.0.0`, mbx `mbx 1.23.0`.

| Warm, other checkout | 2.14 s <sub>1.90–2.55</sub> | 2.14 s <sub>1.84–2.63</sub> | 29.0 s |

| eza | head | base | mbx |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Cold | 60.1 s <sub>57.5–62.7</sub> | 59.6 s <sub>57.7–61.5</sub> | 69.5 s |
| Warm, same path | 0.72 s <sub>0.63–0.94</sub> | 0.66 s <sub>0.62–0.75</sub> | 1.11 s |
| Warm, other checkout | 0.75 s <sub>0.68–0.88</sub> | 0.77 s <sub>0.73–0.88</sub> | 43.7 s |

| aube | head | base | mbx |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Cold | 115 s <sub>113–118</sub> | 113 s <sub>112–113</sub> | 117 s |

Times exclude setup. Each warm build starts from the cold cache snapshot and an empty build directory. Other tools are context and never decide the verdict.

</details>

<details>
<summary>All tools, contention</summary>

| hk | head | base | mbx |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Cold | 102 s <sub>101–106</sub> | 101 s <sub>98.7–108</sub> | 142 s |
| Warm | 9.84 s <sub>9.74–10.2</sub> | 9.93 s <sub>9.38–10.2</sub> | 10.7 s |

| eza | head | base | mbx |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Cold | 51.3 s <sub>47.9–56.0</sub> | 50.6 s <sub>47.9–54.6</sub> | 57.0 s |
| Warm | 3.91 s <sub>3.70–4.50</sub> | 3.93 s <sub>3.63–4.15</sub> | 4.44 s |

| aube | head | base | mbx |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Cold | 238 s <sub>231–258</sub> | 243 s <sub>229–256</sub> | 326 s |
| Warm | 27.2 s <sub>25.8–30.2</sub> | 26.5 s <sub>25.8–27.7</sub> | 38.5 s |

Six Cargo jobs, 6 at once, each with 4 Cargo jobs and its own empty target directory. Each tool shares one store across the six jobs. Every warm batch starts from its cold seed, and fresh cold seeds are measured every sample.

| hk | Compiler runs | Duplicate keys | Flight wait | Permit wait |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| head, cold | 1190.5 | 9 | 1.35 s | 139 s |
| base, cold | 1191 | 9 | 2.27 s | 128 s |
| head, warm | 0 | 0 | 0.00 s | 0.00 s |
| base, warm | 0 | 0 | 0.00 s | 0.00 s |

| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| head, cold | 581 | 0 | 0.00 s | 185 s |
| base, cold | 581 | 0 | 0.00 s | 180 s |
| head, warm | 0 | 0 | 0.00 s | 0.00 s |
| base, warm | 0 | 0 | 0.00 s | 0.00 s |

| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| head, cold | 1759 | 15 | 9.86 s | 1237 s |
| base, cold | 1757 | 13 | 2.12 s | 1210 s |
| head, warm | 0 | 0 | 0.00 s | 0.00 s |
| base, warm | 0 | 0 | 0.00 s | 0.00 s |

Medians per batch. Waits add up overlapping events across jobs, so they are not wall-clock savings.

| Project | Arm | Phase | Skip reason | Extra compiles | Batches | Most repeated crates |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| aube | base | cold | peer-already-committed | 76 | 6 | build_script_build (18), aube_manifest (10), aube_codes (9), aube_runtime (6), aube_scripts (5), 10 more |
| aube | head | cold | peer-already-committed | 86 | 6 | build_script_build (18), aube_codes (8), aube_runtime (7), aube_store (7), aube_util (7), 10 more |
| hk | base | cold | peer-already-committed | 54 | 6 | build_script_mod (18), generate_docs (18), hk (18) |
| hk | head | cold | peer-already-committed | 54 | 6 | build_script_mod (18), generate_docs (18), hk (18) |
Extra compiles are summed over the batches. Unknown means the wrapper did not report a skip reason, and not skipped means both compiles finished without one. Every key is in the subject's perf-gate artifact, in contention/<batch>/events.jsonl.

</details>

Mean allocated blocks after each contention batch. Hardlinks count once, and the total counts blocks shared by the cache and targets once. Reflinked extents are not resolved, so these are not exclusive disk bytes. Sources, Cargo home, logs and cold snapshots are excluded.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Paired comparison</summary>

| Build | hk | eza | aube |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cold | -3.2%, 2 pairs, inconclusive | +0.8%, 2 pairs, inconclusive | +2.4%, 2 pairs, inconclusive |
| Warm, same path | +1.5% (-4.7% to +12.2%), 6 pairs, inconclusive | +11.8% (-3.9% to +24.7%), 6 pairs, inconclusive | +6.4% (-9.7% to +14.1%), 6 pairs, inconclusive |
| Warm, other checkout | +0.7% (-17.0% to +28.1%), 6 pairs, inconclusive | -3.0% (-8.0% to +4.7%), 6 pairs, inconclusive | +3.8% (-0.9% to +4.0%), 6 pairs, inconclusive |
| Contention, cold | +1.6% (-3.3% to +3.0%), 6 pairs, inconclusive | -0.1% (-1.3% to +3.8%), 6 pairs, inconclusive | -0.4% (-3.7% to +2.9%), 6 pairs, inconclusive |
| Contention, warm | -1.1% (-3.6% to +5.3%), 6 pairs, inconclusive | +2.2% (-7.5% to +8.1%), 6 pairs, inconclusive | +2.8% (-1.5% to +12.9%), 6 pairs, inconclusive |
| Cold contention duplicate compiles | 0/0 non-tied pairs grew (6 measured), p=1.0000, inconclusive | 0/0 non-tied pairs grew (6 measured), p=1.0000, inconclusive | 4/5 non-tied pairs grew (6 measured), p=0.1875, inconclusive |

Head and base run as paired samples; positive changes are slower. Parentheses hold the 95% bootstrap interval. A timing regression needs at least 5 pairs, an interval entirely above +5% and a median change above 250 ms; an improvement is the mirror image. Cold duplicate compiles vary with overlap: growth needs a one-sided paired sign test below 0.0167 (0.05 across three subjects). With six cold pairs, all six must grow; a tie or decrease leaves the count result inconclusive. Warm increases in duplicate compiles, misses or passthroughs fail immediately. `samples.json` in the run artifacts has source and tool versions, run order and raw reports.

</details>
